say:1:1536138501:1.text: Dodged a spear there... Word is, only one warrior made it back alive.
say:1:1536138501:1.source_cn: 幸好没去猎血节，听说只有一个人活着回来了……
say:1:1536138501:1.male: Dodged a spear there... Word is, only one warrior made it back alive.
say:1:1536138501:1.female: Dodged a spear there... Word is, only one warrior made it back alive.

say:2:1536138502:1.text: I've been saying it, better to fish in peace than die a hero.
say:2:1536138502:1.source_cn: 唉，早说了嘛，还不如就找个地方钓鱼。
say:2:1536138502:1.male: I've been saying it, better to fish in peace than die a hero.
say:2:1536138502:1.female: I've been saying it, better to fish in peace than die a hero.

say:3:1536138503:1.text: I hate fighting. Why do you have to die to show your faith?
say:3:1536138503:1.source_cn: 我讨厌战斗，又不是死了才能证明对狩猎神的忠诚。
say:3:1536138503:1.male: I hate fighting. Why do you have to die to show your faith?
say:3:1536138503:1.female: I hate fighting. Why do you have to die to show your faith?

say:4:1536138504:1.text: I'd rather stay alive and offer her a few more big catches!
say:4:1536138504:1.source_cn: 我宁愿多活几年，多给她献上一些大鱼！
say:4:1536138504:1.male: I'd rather stay alive and offer her a few more big catches!
say:4:1536138504:1.female: I'd rather stay alive and offer her a few more big catches!
